title: Iraq closes Sheeb border crossing with Iran for urgent security reasons, sources say
summary: Iraq has shut down the Sheeb border crossing with Iran due to urgent security concerns. The closure affects passengers, vehicles, and commercial trucks.

title: Qatari emir hosts French president for official talks
summary: Qatar's Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al-Thani hosted French President Emmanuel Macron for official talks at Lusail Palace, marking the first state visit by a French leader to Qatar. The discussions focused on strengthening bilateral cooperation across various sectors, including economic, investment, security, and defense, as Macron also seeks to secure additional diesel supplies during his Gulf visit.

title: UN projections say world is losing ground in fight to curb climate change, faulting US a bit
summary: A UN report warns that the world is on track for increased warming this century, largely due to the United States abandoning climate efforts.

title: Saudi coalition intercepts 5 drones in Eastern, Madinah regions
summary: The Coalition Forces have intercepted and destroyed four drones heading toward Saudi Arabia. This action was confirmed by Brig. Gen. Turki Al-Malki, spokesman for the Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen.

title: Canada, Turkey to agree during Carney visit to deepen defence and energy ties, source says
summary: ANKARA/TORONTO: NATO allies Canada and Turkiye are expected to sign a joint declaration aimed at deepening bilateral cooperation in four areas, including defense and energy, during Prime Minister Mark Carney’s visit later this week, a person briefed on the matter said. title: Nigeria confirms Ebola case in Abuja as woman who arrived from Uganda tests positive
summary: LAGOS, Nigeria: Nigeria confirmed an Ebola case in its capital, Abuja, on Tuesday after a woman who arrived from Uganda tested positive for the virus, the Health Ministry said. The woman began showing symptoms on Oct. 7 and was admitted to a private hospital in Abuja on Oct. 11, where she was later diagnosed with Ebola.
